title: The Old Hunters' Camp
text: Trophies, bones and rusted traps litter a camp where a lean-to rots in the rain. Years ago someone hunted the same quarry here, keeping careful notes. The last pages are spattered. The last line says only: it learns.

options.label: The wisest reads the spattered notes, to learn what the hunter learned too late.

outcomes.text: They tell of its habits, its weak side and how it always turns left. The last pages are about how it stopped turning left.

options.label: Mend the old traps and carry them along, so what hunted him finds iron first.

outcomes.text: The old iron is still good. You set it around camp each night, and nothing trips it yet.

options.label: Take the dead hunter's trophies; he will not need them now.

outcomes.text: Among the heads and horns is an ivory you cannot place. They will sell.
